name: Paradise Lost
overview: Paradise Lost (2004) is the inaugural visual novel in the Shinza Bansho franchise by developer Light (written by Takashi Masada). It explores the dark, post-apocalyptic "Second Heaven," centering on Lyle, a ruthless mercenary, and Lilliel, an angel. Their journey exposes the cycle of violence and original sin defining their shattered world.
